title: Voxyris
description: Seamless combination of Voxy and Iris shaders. Enjoy massive render distance with shaders and great performance!
body:
### 📖 About **Voxyris** is a seamless combination of [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) and [Iris shaders](https://modrinth.com/project/YL57xq9U). Enjoy massive render distance with shaders and great performance! ### 🧩 Why 2 versions of Voxyris? For server support to work you need [Voxy Server](https://modrinth.com/project/fNtGd1cx) mod, But it's incompatible with [Voxy WorldGen](https://modrinth.com/project/xT0lnNE9) (Mod that automaticly generates Voxy's chunks past your vanilla render distance). Pregenarate your world with chunky! Command: /chunky If you want to play on servers, use [Voxyris: Multiplayer](https://modrinth.com/project/Gxjvky9m) If you want to play singleplayer, use [Voxyris](https://modrinth.com/project/zwghPdKt) --- ### 🛠️ Features: - ~~🌐 Multiplayer Support~~ (For this use [Voxyris: Server](https://modrinth.com/project/Gxjvky9m), Available soon) - 🌱 Automatic generation of Voxy's chunks - 📷 In-game screenshot manager. - 📦 Fast chunk generation. - 🌍 Up to 2048 chunk render distance. - 💡 Shader support with 20+ preinstalled. - 📊 Low memory usage (4GB for 256 render distance). - ⚡ Lightweight & Fully optimized. - 🔍 Zooming in retains quality of chunks. --- ### ✨ Shaders [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) only works with shader packs that explicitly add support for it. 21 compatible shader packs come preinstalled. You can find more here: https://samalando.com/voxy/shaders ![Mountain side screenshot with shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zwghPdKt/images/4becd8af95517a4840eed9b60ca9aadb3d4bf39a.png) --- ### ⚡ Performance Stable ~280 fps With 512 Render distance on **6 year old Laptop Gpu**, and 4GB of allocated ram. Performance will vary depending on your hardware. Performance tested on Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz; 16GB 2933MT/s ram (4GB Allocated); NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 Ti 4GB (laptop edition) using lower lowest quality of chunks. ![Performance showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a1b0dd42342d1e3d8d121013b89431534ff4cf7.webp) --- ### 🔎 Zoom [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) adjusts the [level of detail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_of_detail_(computer_graphics)) of chunks depending on how much screen space they actually take up. This means that even if you zoom in from far away, you won't end up looking at massive, single-colored blocks. ![Gif - zoom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zwghPdKt/images/c5b30b8acc59fe2260b47216e38281b0b641c1aa.gif) --- ### 🌍 Extreme render distance [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) can render up to 2048 chunks in each directions. ![render distance 512 showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5af5b7ed798f5e3c42e22bb2e13cb741caba3c01.webp) ---
💡 FAQ ### What is Voxy? [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) is a mod made by [Cortex](https://modrinth.com/user/f45kBWbv) that uses [Level of Detail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_of_detail_(computer_graphics)) to let you see beyond your normal render distance. ### **How to toggle shaders?** Press "K" to toggle shaders, Press "O" to open shader pack menu or go to Options -> Video Setting -> Shader Packs ### **How to change Voxy's render distance?** Go to options -> video settings -> Voxy -> Rendering ### **How to change quality of voxy's chunks?** Go to options -> video settings -> Voxy -> Rendering -> "Pixels^2 of subdivison size" The higher the setting lower the quality. ### **Bedrock support?** No. ### **Will you release for x.x.x Minecraft version?** Only the newest version of Voxy will be supported.
📌 Requirements A GPU/IGPU with [OpenGl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenGL) 4.6 support (this means very old GPUs like 10+ years old or Macs don’t work but to make sure your GPU has Opengl 4.6 support you can always check online) [Optional] For GPU accelerated chunk generation look at requirements here: [C2ME OpenCL Acceleration Module](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-ocl)
🔍 Credits Voxyris's logo is combination of [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK)'s and [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/project/YL57xq9U)' Logo.
